_comment: One entry per session bot the daemon bridges. Copy to ~/.cc-channels/.telegram-bridge/bots.json. The token is NOT here — the daemon reads it from ~/.cc-channels/<label>/telegram.env. allowedChats is the MANDATORY sender allowlist (bypassed-permission sessions: ungated inbound = code execution); a message from any other chat is dropped. Each label must be a launcher-managed session (a session-id record exists) or the daemon refuses to start.
